## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass on a supported Python version.
- [ ] `ruff check src tests examples` passes.
- [ ] Protocol changes update `docs/PROTOCOL.md` and use an explicit version plan.
- [ ] User-visible changes update `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No credentials, private identities, encoded personal messages, or account automation
      are included.
- [ ] `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` remain intact.
